description: List the curated conditions the trial search tools filter on, with the slug to pass as `condition` (clinicaltrials_search_trials, clinicaltrials_count_trials) or in `conditions` (clinicaltrials_find_eligible_trials). Pass `query` to find a condition by name or synonym (e.g. 'lung', 'diabetes', 'NSCLC'). Ordered by how many recruiting US trials study the condition. Specialty entries (e.g. 'oncology') are roll-ups covering many conditions.

limit.description: Maximum conditions to return. Integer in [1, 250]. Default 50.

query.description: Case-insensitive search over condition labels, slugs and synonyms (the raw condition names trial records use). Omit to list the most common conditions.

name: clinicaltrials_list_conditions

isSpecialty.description: True for roll-ups that cover a whole specialty (e.g. oncology).

slug.description: Value to pass as a condition filter.

totalMatching.description: Matching conditions before the limit was applied.

title: List Conditions
